notes.title: Update 11/16/2017
notes.content:
* Fixed incorrect kite behaviour
* Improved controller detection and handling
* Improved input change. Better system for switching from motion -> gamepad and vice versa.
* Fixed minor UI errors
* Added start screen 
* Support for "Mixed Reality" (known issue: key bindings for new controller not shown correctly in game)
